entities.name: Network handling of invalid PDU session identity
entities.description: Network procedures for handling unknown, erroneous, or unforeseen PDU session identity values received in 5GSM message headers.

entities.name: UE handling of invalid PDU session identity
entities.description: UE procedures for handling unknown, erroneous, or unforeseen PDU session identity values received in 5GSM message headers.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: 5GSM message used by UE to request modification of a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT
entities.description: 5GSM message sent by network to reject a PDU session modification request.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST
entities.description: 5GSM message used by UE to request release of a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT
entities.description: 5GSM message sent by network to reject a PDU session release request.

entities.name: UL NAS TRANSPORT
entities.description: Uplink NAS transport message carrying 5GSM messages.

entities.name: DL NAS TRANSPORT
entities.description: Downlink NAS transport message carrying 5GSM messages.

entities.name: 5GSM STATUS
entities.description: 5GSM message used to report error conditions.

entities.name: Request type
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of request in UL NAS TRANSPORT messages.

entities.name: PDU session identity
entities.description: Identifier for PDU sessions included in 5GSM message headers.

entities.name: 5GSM cause #43
entities.description: Cause value indicating 'invalid PDU session identity'.

entities.name: 5GMM cause #90
entities.description: Cause value indicating 'payload was not forwarded'.

entities.name: Invalid PDU session identity condition
entities.description: Condition where PDU session identity is unassigned, reserved, or does not match existing session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION INACTIVE
entities.description: PDU session state where session is inactive in the UE.

relations.description: Network procedure includes handling PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST with invalid PDU session identity.

PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT message includes 5GSM cause #43.

DL NAS TRANSPORT message includes 5GMM cause #90.
